name: Docling
description: Parses PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, audio, and image files into a unified DoclingDocument and exports Markdown, HTML, DocTags, or lossless JSON for gen-AI pipelines.

skills.name: PDF Layout Understanding
skills.description: Resolves page layout, reading order, table structure, code blocks, and formulas in PDFs, with OCR for scanned pages and images.

skills.name: Multi Format Parsing
skills.description: Parses DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, email, LaTeX, XBRL, and image files into one unified DoclingDocument representation.

skills.name: Structured Document Export
skills.description: Exports parsed documents to Markdown, HTML, WebVTT, DocTags, or lossless JSON for chunking, indexing, and retrieval workflows.

skills.name: VLM And ASR Pipelines
skills.description: Runs vision-language models such as GraniteDocling and speech recognition models to interpret images, charts, and audio tracks.

skills.name: MCP And API Serving
skills.description: Serves conversions to agents through the docling-mcp server or the docling-serve HTTP API, running locally or against a remote endpoint.
